name: ANTItrust
caption: A four-man stable on UCWF’s own roster, the first of the three it listed and the only one whose name reads like a company rather than a gang.

name: American Bad Boyz
caption: The largest of the three stables UCWF listed, five men deep, and the one its own singles roster carries most of.

name: The G's

tenures.source: won the UCWF Tag Team titles by disqualification over the Krazy-Wacko Connection at Fury 2002-09-08, then ran in on a non-title three-way at Immortality 2002 to beat down its participants (promotions/ucwf/archive/fury-2002-09-08.html; promotions/ucwf/archive/immortality-2002.html)

caption: Won the UCWF Tag Team titles by disqualification at Fury 2002, then ran in on a three-way at Immortality the same year.

name: The Krazy-Wacko Connection

tenures.source: loses the UCWF Tag Team titles by disqualification to The G's at Fury 2002-09-08, wins them back from Dark Carnival at Immortality 2002, and retains them over Italian Organized Crime at Resurrection 2003 (promotions/ucwf/archive/fury-2002-09-08.html; promotions/ucwf/archive/immortality-2002.html; promotions/ucwf/archive/resurrection-2003.html)

caption: UCWF Tag Team Champions across three of the fed's own surviving shows, on and off.

identity.note: The mint guard flags a normalized substring match against the existing unit named bare 'Connection'. Nothing connects them: this tag team is billed The Krazy Kid and Mr. Wacko across UCWF's own show scripts. Recorded distinct under the collision doctrine, not merged.

name: Dark Carnival

tenures.source: loses the UCWF Tag Team titles to the Krazy-Wacko Connection at Immortality 2002 (promotions/ucwf/archive/immortality-2002.html)

caption: Lost the UCWF Tag Team titles to the Krazy-Wacko Connection at Immortality 2002.

identity.note: The mint guard flags a normalized substring match against dark-carnival-faw's own aka Dark Carnival eVolution. Nothing connects them: this Dark Carnival is billed on UCWF's own Immortality 2002 show script as Crush and Brent Hunter, a different fed. Recorded distinct under the collision doctrine, not merged.

name: Italian Organized Crime

tenures.source: loses the UCWF Tag Team titles to the Krazy-Wacko Connection at Resurrection 2003 (promotions/ucwf/archive/resurrection-2003.html)

caption: Challenged for the UCWF Tag Team titles at Resurrection 2003 and lost.

name: Money Train
caption: The third and last of the three stables UCWF's own June 2003 roster listed.

identity.note: The mint guard flags a decorated-aka substring match against the bare unit 'Money' and against wayne-rothschild-ewa's own aka 'The Train'. Nothing connects them: this Money Train is UCWF's own three-man stable of Rich Bitch, Assout Poor and Big Poppa Pimp, named on the fed's own June 2003 stable roster. Recorded distinct under the collision doctrine, not merged.

name: A.C.E.

tenures.source: won the UCWF Tag Team titles from the Krazy-Wacko Connection at Wrestle Insanity 2003 (promotions/ucwf/archive/wrestle-insanity-2003.html)

caption: Won the UCWF Tag Team titles from the Krazy-Wacko Connection at Wrestle Insanity 2003, the last team the surviving record shows holding them.

name: Unforeseen Vengeance

tenures.source: formed mid-match during Immortality 2002's own Extreme/World Hell in a Cell, when a masked Solidus unmasks and Coley Walsh returns to join Brax and The Fox (promotions/ucwf/archive/immortality-2002.html)

caption: Formed mid-match at Immortality 2002 when a masked Solidus unmasked and a returning Coley Walsh joined Brax and The Fox; never named on the fed's own later stable roster.

identity.note: The mint guard flags a decorated-aka substring match against vengeance-cswa's own aka 'Vengeance'. Nothing connects them: this Unforeseen Vengeance is UCWF's own stable, formed mid-match at Immortality 2002 by Brax, The Fox, Solidus and a returning Coley Walsh, a different fed. Recorded distinct under the collision doctrine, not merged.
